blocks.text: These Terms govern your use of Itinosu, a personal organiser for your own travel plans, bookings and expenses, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Itinosu Terms of Use. Effective 22nd Nov 2026. Version 2.
1. Who we are and what Itinosu is

Itinosu is a personal project, made and looked after by one independent developer in India in their spare time ("we", "us"), not by a company. We take your data and these Terms just as seriously. The developer's name is shown as the seller on Itinosu's App Store page. Itinosu is an app for storing and organising travel details you enter yourself: visas, flights, insurance, stays, places, activities, transport, rentals, expenses, notes and related documents, plus a summary built from them. The Itinosu website gives information about the app only; you use Itinosu through the app.
Itinosu is not a booking platform. We do not book, sell or manage flights, hotels, visas or insurance, and we are not a party to any of your bookings.
2. Agreeing to these Terms
By ticking the box and creating an account, or by continuing with Apple or Google, you agree to these Terms and acknowledge our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account.
3. Who can use Itinosu

You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding contract. We ask for your date of birth when you set up your profile, and Itinosu cannot be used with a date of birth under 18. If we learn an account belongs to someone under 18, we may close it and delete its data.
4. Your account

items: You can sign in with Apple, with Google, or with an email address and password. If you use Sign in with Apple and choose Hide My Email, we only see Apple's relay address.
Give accurate information, and keep your name and date of birth up to date.
Keep your password and sign-in methods secure. You are responsible for activity on your account.
One account per person. Do not share your account.
Tell us promptly at itinosu@gmail.com if you think someone else has accessed your account.

blocks.text: 5. Your content
"Your content" means everything you enter or upload: trip details, costs, notes, links, cover photos and documents such as boarding passes, visa documents and policy files.

items: You own your content. We do not claim ownership of it.
You give us a limited licence to store, process and display your content only to run Itinosu for you, for example to show it back to you on your devices and to build your summary and downloads.
Only upload what you have the right to upload, and only what you need: avoid documents or ID numbers that are not required for your trip.
Attachments must be PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC/HEIF, up to 10 MB per file and 5 files per entry. We may change these limits.
Your content is private to your account. We do not use it for advertising and do not sell it.

blocks.text: 6. Acceptable use
Do not:

items: break the law, or upload content that infringes others’ rights or contains malware;
try to access other users’ data, probe or bypass our security, or overload the service;
scrape, copy or resell the service, or reverse-engineer it except where law allows;
use Itinosu to harass anyone or to store unlawful material.

blocks.text: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these rules, after notice where reasonable.
7. Free trial and Itinosu Plus

Every new account gets a free trial, currently 5 days from when the account is created. The trial includes every feature except attachments. No payment details are needed for the trial and it does not turn into a paid plan by itself.

Itinosu Plus is an optional paid subscription. It currently includes unlimited trips, attachments up to 10 MB each and custom cover photos. It is offered as a yearly or a monthly auto-renewing subscription. The price, the length of each period and what is included are shown in the app before you buy. Which features belong to Plus can change; we will tell you in the app before a change affects what you have paid for.

items: Itinosu Plus is bought through Apple's App Store with In-App Purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.

The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the period ends. Your Apple Account is charged for the next period within the 24 hours before the current one ends.

You can manage or cancel your subscription with Manage Subscription in the app (Settings › Itinosu Plus), or in your Apple Account's subscription settings: on iPhone and iPad in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions, on Mac in the App Store app › your name › Account Settings › Subscriptions. Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep Plus until the end of the period you paid for.
Deleting the app or your Itinosu account does not cancel your subscription. Cancel it with Apple.
Refunds are handled by Apple under Apple's policies. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com.
If prices change, Apple tells subscribers in advance and, where required, asks you to agree before you are charged the new price.
A subscription belongs to the Itinosu account that bought it and works on your iPhone, iPad and Mac when you sign in to that account. Use Restore Purchases if Plus does not show on a device.

blocks.text: 8. When the trial or a subscription ends
If your trial ends without a purchase, or your subscription ends and is not renewed:

items: Your account is restricted at once: you can still sign in, view your trips, download your data and delete things, but you cannot create or change trips, entries or files.
7 days later, if you still have not subscribed, all your trips, entries and files are permanently deleted. Your account itself stays, so you can subscribe later and start again.
We remind you in the app before the trial ends and before the deletion date, and the app shows the deletion date and offers Download Your Data until then.
While Apple is retrying a failed payment, your subscription still counts as active.

blocks.text: 9. Downloading and deleting your data

items: You can download your data at any time from Settings › Download Your Data: a ZIP file with a PDF summary of each trip, a JSON file with all your entries, and your attachments. It is free for everyone.

You can delete a trip, an entry or your whole account from the app. After you confirm, deletion is immediate and permanent and cannot be undone. Deleting your account deletes your profile, trips, entries and uploaded files.
If you use Sign in with Apple, deleting your account also ends Itinosu's access to your Apple Account.

blocks.text: 10. Travel information: please read
Itinosu shows what you enter. We do not check it, so the summary is a compilation of your own information, not a verified or official record.

items: Itinosu is not legal, immigration, visa, insurance, medical or financial advice. Check requirements with the relevant authority, airline, insurer or provider.
Do not rely on Itinosu as your only copy of a document you need for travel or border control. Keep originals and an offline copy.
Reminders and widgets are a convenience and may not appear, for example if notifications are turned off. Do not rely on them alone.
We aim for a reliable service but do not promise it will always be available, error-free or usable without internet.

blocks.text: 11. Third-party services and links

You can sign in with Apple or Google, buy Itinosu Plus through the App Store and save links to other websites. Those services have their own terms and privacy practices, and we are not responsible for them. Itinosu does not make payments to, or exchange data with, airlines, hotels or insurers on your behalf.

Feedback you send us may be used to improve Itinosu without obligation to you.
13. Ending your use

You can stop using Itinosu and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end your access if you break these Terms, if the law requires it, or if we stop running the service, giving reasonable notice and a chance to download your data where we can.
14. Disclaimers and limits on liability
Itinosu is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows:

items: we do not give warranties beyond those the law requires;
we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss caused by incorrect information you entered, missed travel, denied boarding or entry, or events outside our control.

blocks.text: 16. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms. For material changes we will give notice in the app or by email and, where the law requires, ask you to accept again. Continuing to use Itinosu after the effective date means you accept the update.
17. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of India, without limiting any mandatory consumer protection you have where you live. Please contact us first at itinosu@gmail.com so we can try to resolve a problem within 30 days.
18. Contact
Questions, support or complaints: itinosu@gmail.com. Itinosu's developer is based in India.
